title: The Debate Over Remote Work
text:
Remote work has become increasingly common since the pandemic. Nevertheless, many companies remain uncertain about whether employees are as productive at home as they are in an office. Consequently, several firms have conducted trials to measure output over extended periods.

The results of these trials have been mixed. Some reported a substantial increase in productivity, while others noted that communication became slower. In addition, employees with young children often found it difficult to maintain a consistent routine.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what have several firms done?
options: Hired more employees to work at home

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what did some trials report?
What can be inferred about the effect of remote work?
options: It suits every type of employee equally
Its effects depend on individual circumstances
Companies have fully decided against it

questions.text: Why does the writer mention employees with young children?
options: To suggest that remote work is unsuitable for parents
To show that some workers face particular challenges
To argue that children should work from home
To explain why offices are closing

paragraph_translations: El trabajo remoto se ha vuelto cada vez más común desde la pandemia. Sin embargo, muchas empresas todavía no están seguras de si los empleados son tan productivos en casa como en la oficina. Por consiguiente, varias firmas han realizado pruebas para medir el rendimiento durante períodos prolongados.

Los resultados de estas pruebas han sido mixtos. Algunas informaron un aumento considerable de la productividad, mientras que otras señalaron que la comunicación se volvió más lenta. Además, los empleados con hijos pequeños a menudo encontraron difícil mantener una rutina constante.
